listing.name: God of War Recomp (KIexster)
listing.summary: Explore God of War Recomp (KIexster) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Prepare upstream or keep an existing game build
steps.instruction: Use upstream’s Building and running guide with your own God of War NTSC-U SCUS-97399 files. The documented game host is ps2EntryRunner.exe. Preserve the prepared working folder and the launch arguments specified by that guide in Change launch details. Portcove does not run the PS2 recompiler or build scripts during discovery.

steps.title: Keep your files and update through upstream
steps.instruction: Use a separate folder you control and retain your working copy. An existing native player can use Portcove’s non-owning registration after the read-only executable review; choose Play separately. You or upstream keep runtime updates, original files, generated data, saves and settings. Portcove does not replace, back up or roll back this external runtime. Follow the selected upstream version’s instructions when changing it.
